name: Tsuchimikado-sensei to xx na Himitsu
original_name: 土御門先生と××なヒ・ミ・ツ
source:
Tsuchimikado Jin (the protagonist), the heir to a prestigious hospital, graduated from a top university and was set to take over as director from his father. However, after it came to light that he’d been “treating” girls inappropriately, he was sent to work at a small clinic in a remote mountain village to let the scandal blow over.
Back then, he messed up—but this time, he’s not going to make the same stupid mistakes.
Jin, completely unrepentant about his past misdeeds in Tokyo, starts indulging his desires with the two girls he meets in the village. But things might not go as smoothly as he expects…

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ003907.html/]dlsite[/url]]
translation:
土御门仁（主角）是一家名牌医院的继承人，毕业于顶尖大学，即将从父亲手中接任院长。然而，当他不当“对待”女孩的行为曝光后，他被派到偏远山村的一家小诊所工作，让丑闻平息。
当年，他搞砸了——但这一次，他不会再犯同样的愚蠢错误了。
金对自己过去在东京的罪行完全不悔，开始与村里遇到的两个女孩一起放纵自己的欲望。但事情或许并没有他想象的那么顺利……
